_about: 2-Butanone (1) + Isopropyl acetate (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.33 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-butanone, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 2-butanone, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Q. Xie, H. Wan, M. Han, G. Guan, Investigation on isobaric vapor liquid equilibrium for acetic acid +water +methyl ethyl ketone + isopropyl acetate, Fluid Phase Equilib. 280 (2009) 120-128
